title: Bear Spirit Portrait
description: A surreal portrait of a woman with long flowing hair in swirling patterns of orange, yellow, and pink. She wears an ornate bear mask with large blue eyes, while vibrant orange poppies with green leaves grow across her face and neck against a dark swirling cosmic background.
prompt: Surreal portrait of a beautiful woman with pale skin and dramatic makeup, wearing an ornate stylized bear headdress with big blue eyes and a realistic bear snout. Her long hair flows in hypnotic swirling patterns of orange, yellow, pink and red. Bright orange poppies with green stems and leaves grow across her face and chest. Dark swirling cosmic background with teal and gold spirals, mystical and ethereal atmosphere, detailed painting style.
